angle: A lighthouse keeper climbs the same hill every morning to trim the wick and clean the glass, with nobody watching. Years later a storm hides the stars and a lost ship finds its way home by his light. The small habit nobody saw is what saved it.
lesson: Small steps still count, even when nobody sees them.
audience: Someone who keeps putting off a thing because one small step feels too small to matter.
titles: One Small Habit, One Stormy Night
